rounds.notes: Full-file review across durability helpers, all five sidecar call sites, the worker brief-path branch, frontend degradation, and tests. No issues found.

Found 2 real bugs. BLOCKING: materializeBriefFromStore returned false on ANY exception, so the worker converted a transient store/network error into a permanent BriefNotFoundError drop (silent loss of a recoverable queued job). SHOULD-FIX: the parent-directory confinement check under-blocked Windows cross-drive and UNC paths and over-blocked a legitimate child name beginning with double-dot.

Re-reviewed the two fixes (throw-on-transient materialize contract with a best-effort tryMaterialiseBrief wrapper at the five sidecar sites; shared isRepoConfined using both win32 and posix isAbsolute). Confirmed both concerns fully resolved with no new issues; 119/119 targeted tests pass.
